note: Triennial election of the county council, 1939: nominations received by T. E. Reid, M.B.E., 25 April 1939; contests in Armagh and Crossmaglen, polled 25 May 1939. Polled 25 May 1939, counted 26 May. Printed "Armagh Town". Agnew was Labour M.P. for South Armagh; McLaughlin, a senator, was the retiring member. "The first time that Labour has been represented on the County Council." 14 spoilt.
